emojis.title: A Syrian Holdout Province, Sweida, Fears a Government Takeover
emojis.summary: In Sweida Province, dominated by the country’s Druse minority, many say it is just a matter of time before the central government moves to assert control over the region.

emojis.label: russian civilian deaths rising
emojis.title: Russian Civilian Deaths Are Growing Rapidly as Ukraine Expands Its Air War
emojis.summary: The higher tempo of Ukrainian strikes has fueled discontent among Russians, but it is far from clear that it will change the Kremlin’s calculus about the war.

emojis.label: iceland awaits solar eclipse
emojis.title: The Eclipse Is Coming, and Iceland Is Looking for a Break in the Clouds
emojis.summary: Rooms were booked years ago, and officials have been making plans. But there’s no telling where, exactly, Icelanders might go to find the best possible view.

emojis.label: colombia earthquake rescue efforts
emojis.title: As Death Toll From Colombia Earthquake Rises to at Least 181, Rescuers Hunt for Survivors
emojis.summary: “We heard them screaming,” said one rescuer in Cali, where emergency workers and volunteers are racing against time to find the living trapped in the rubble.

emojis.title: Syria Sentences Former President al-Assad to Death for Crimes Against Humanity
emojis.summary: The former president was convicted of crimes against humanity during the country’s civil war, the first verdict since he fled to Russia in 2024.
